cases.note: a cryptographic check on G_X, not part of the CDDL. The trace says: Curve25519 point of low order which fails the check for all-zero output according to Section 9.2 of {{I-D.ietf-lake-edhoc}}.
cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Curve point of low order

cases.note: the leading zeros of G_X are a rule of the encoding of keys, not of the CDDL. The trace says: Invalid encoding of third element (G_X). Correct encoding is with leading zeros according to Section 3.7 of {{I-D.ietf-lake-edhoc}} and Section 7.1.1 of {{RFC9053}}.

cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Error in elliptic curve point

cases.note: a cryptographic check on G_X, not part of the CDDL. The trace says: Invalid x-coordinate in G_X as x {{{≥}}} p. Requirement that x < p according to Section 9.2 of {{I-D.ietf-lake-edhoc}} and Section 5.6.2.3 of {{SP-800-56A}}.
cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Error in elliptic curve representation

cases.note: the length of G_X depends on the cipher suite, not on the CDDL. The trace says: Invalid length of the third element (G_X). cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Error in length of ephemeral key

cases.note: the length of the MAC depends on the cipher suite, not on the CDDL. The trace says: Invalid length of third element (Signature_or_MAC_2). The length of Signature_or_MAC_2 is given by the cipher suite and the MAC length is at least 8 bytes according to Section 9.3 of {{I-D.ietf-lake-edhoc}}.
cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Error in length of MAC

cases.note: valid CDDL, but not deterministically encoded (RFC 8949 §4.2.1), which EDHOC requires: checked with `require_deterministic`. The trace says: Invalid indefinite-length array encoding 9F 06 02 FF of SUITES_I = [6, 2]. Correct encoding is 82 06 02 according to Section 5.2.2 of {{I-D.ietf-lake-edhoc}}.
cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Indefinite-length array encoding

cases.note: without `require_deterministic` only the CDDL is checked
cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Indefinite-length array encoding

cases.note: `suites = [ 2* int ] / int`: an array of one is not allowed. The trace says: Invalid array encoding 81 02 of SUITES_I = 2. Correct encoding is 02 according to Section 5.2.2 of {{I-D.ietf-lake-edhoc}}.
cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Surplus array encoding of ciphersuite

cases.note: the message is one array, not a sequence. The trace says: Invalid encoding of message_1 as array. Correct encoding is a CBOR sequence according to Section 5.2.1 of {{I-D.ietf-lake-edhoc}}.
cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Surplus array encoding of message

cases.note: `C_I : bstr / -24..23` allows a byte string: EDHOC's own rule against it is not in the CDDL. The trace says: Invalid encoding 41 0e of C_I = 0x0e. Correct encoding is 0e according to Section 3.3.2 of {{I-D.ietf-lake-edhoc}}.
cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Surplus bstr encoding of connection identifier

cases.note: `ID_CRED_R` allows a byte string: EDHOC's own rule against it is not in the CDDL. The trace says: Invalid encoding 41 32 of ID_CRED_R in PLAINTEXT_2. Correct encoding is 32 according to Section 3.5.3.2 of {{I-D.ietf-lake-edhoc}}.
cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Surplus bstr encoding of ID_CRED field

cases.note: `ID_CRED_R : header_map / bstr / -24..23` allows a map: EDHOC's own rule against it is not in the CDDL. The trace says: Invalid encoding a1 04 42 32 10 of ID_CRED_R in PLAINTEXT_2. Correct encoding is 42 32 10 according to Section 3.5.3.2 of {{I-D.ietf-lake-edhoc}}.
cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Surplus map encoding of ID_CRED field

cases.note: G_X is a byte string. The trace says: Invalid type of the third element (G_X). Correct encoding is a byte string according to Section 5.2.1 of {{I-D.ietf-lake-edhoc}}.
cases.source: draft-ietf-lake-traces.md, Invalid Traces: Text string encoding of ephemeral key
